dateLabel: c. 499 CE (author was 23 in 499; exact composition date uncertain)
title: Aryabhata's Aryabhatiya
summary: Aryabhata wrote a treatise on mathematics and astronomy, including a place-value system and pi to four decimal places.
why: The start of the classical age of Indian mathematics and astronomy.

notes.problem: Source says the 499 reference does not mean the text was composed then.
